text:
maya: Heads-up — planning a short rolling maintenance this Thu 02:00-03:30 UTC to rebalance cold KV caches across shared GPU pools in EU and APAC. Expected per-rack drain ~6-8m, staggered, no full outage. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cold-cache-rebalance :hourglass_flowing_sand:

alex: What's the impact on Dedicated customers? any SLA wiggle?

maya: Dedicated pools unaffected; we'll only touch shared-hosted GPU pools and preemptible backfill. routing will favor dedicated and eu-burst during the window.

jin: Any cost bump from backfill? rough estimate?

maya: ~+$1.2k USD for the 90m window (preemptible spin + egress), mostly APAC burst. finance already gave a green light for this quarter.

sam: Need oncall coverage? @sre-oncall can you be available for the first 30m for rollback and hotfix?

sre-oncall: I can be on call. If p95 latency > 300ms for >5m we rollback to warm-cache fallback and stop new drains.

maya: Ops plan summary: cordon -> drain pods -> reboot node only if thermal spike or GPU health non-OK -> uncordon. Example command we run per rack: ```./ops drain-node --rack $RACK --timeout 420 --wait-for-grace```

lia: Is KV cache reseed included? we need kv-seed within 2m of uncordon or clients see burst latency.

maya: Yes — kv-seed is in the preheat lambda. It will trigger right after uncordon. We'll watch seed-success metric and p50/p95 PRR.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: Thursday 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC — cold-cache rebalance (eng-infra). React with :thumbsup: to ack.

alex: :thumbsup:

jin: ack

sam: ack

maya: Thanks — I'll post the final per-rack schedule (CSV) and the post-mortem template after the run. If anyone has a hard constraint for APAC morning users, flag it now so we can move that rack to the last cohort.
